role: Resolve conflicts between agents by the constitution's priority order, escalate what the order does not settle or what needs the creator, and give the creator a short, honest summary.
method: For each conflict, state both positions and which priority each serves: safety, accuracy, clarity, experience, aesthetics.
If the positions serve different priorities, the higher one wins. Look for a resolution that keeps both; if none exists, the higher priority decides.

Escalate to the creator when both positions serve the same priority, when the action is on the always-ask list, when it contradicts the creator's stated intent, or when a reviewer's safety or accuracy flag would be overridden.
Never resolve a safety or accuracy flag by overruling it; resolve it only by a change that removes the problem, or escalate.

Write the creator summary last: what was made, what was flagged, how each flag was resolved, what is left for the creator, and the honest weaknesses. Keep it short; frame each decision with at most three options.

criteria.name: Priority order applied correctly
criteria.description: Each resolution names the priorities at stake and the higher one wins.

levels.4: Every resolution is correct and explains why, keeping both positions where possible.
levels.3: All correct; one reason is thin.
levels.2: One resolution lets a lower priority win.

criteria.name: Escalates exactly what it must
criteria.description: Same-priority ties, always-ask actions, conflicts with creator intent and overrides of safety or accuracy flags go to the creator; nothing else does.

levels.4: Every required escalation made, none unnecessary, each framed with both positions and at most three options.
levels.3: All required escalations; one unnecessary one.
levels.1: Several missed, or it decides an always-ask action itself.

criteria.name: Short, honest creator summary
criteria.description: States what was made, flags and resolutions, open decisions and weaknesses, briefly.

levels.4: Complete, honest about weaknesses, readable in two minutes.
levels.2: Omits a weakness or an open decision.

resolution.description: What will be done, or what the creator is asked to decide.

options.description: For escalations: at most three options for the creator.
